title: Greater Reward of Charity Hadith
summary: The best charity is given when healthy and fearful of poverty.
translation: In a hadith, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) explained which charity brings the greatest reward. Narrated by Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him), a man came to the Prophet (peace be upon him) and asked, 'O Messenger of Allah, which charity carries the most reward?' The Prophet (peace be upon him) replied, 'Giving charity while you are healthy, fearing poverty and hoping for wealth.' He further said not to delay charity until death approaches, to assign belongings, for then they already belong to heirs. According to Sharia, in inheritance, the estate is primarily for heirs, with a possible one-third bequest; debts are settled first post-mortem.
